class.name: OcgBrepmeshDatastructureofdelaun
class.brief_description: Describes the data structure necessary for the mesh algorithms in two dimensions plane or on surface by meshing in UV space.
class.description: ! Describes the data structure necessary for the mesh algorithms in ! two dimensions plane or on surface by meshing in UV space.

method.name: BRepMesh_DataStructureOfDelaun
method.description: Constructor.

method.name: NbNodes
method.description: Returns number of nodes.

method.name: AddNode
method.description: Adds node to the mesh if it is not already in the mesh.

method.name: IndexOf_1
method.description: Finds the index of the given node.

method.name: GetNode
method.description: Get node by the index.

method.name: SubstituteNode
method.description: Substitutes the node with the given index by new one.

method.name: RemoveNode
method.description: Removes node from the mesh in case if it has no connected links and its type is Free.

method.name: NbLinks
method.description: Returns number of links.

method.name: AddLink
method.description: Adds link to the mesh if it is not already in the mesh.

method.name: IndexOf_2
method.description: Finds the index of the given link.

method.name: GetLink
method.description: Get link by the index.

method.name: SubstituteLink
method.description: Substitutes the link with the given index by new one.

method.name: RemoveLink
method.description: Removes link from the mesh in case if it has no connected elements and its type is Free.

method.name: ElementsConnectedTo
method.description: Returns indices of elements connected to the link with the given index.

method.name: NbElements
method.description: Returns number of links.

method.name: AddElement
method.description: Adds element to the mesh if it is not already in the mesh.

method.name: GetElement
method.description: Get element by the index.

method.name: SubstituteElement
method.description: Substitutes the element with the given index by new one.

method.name: RemoveElement
method.description: Removes element from the mesh.

method.name: Allocator
method.description: Returns memory allocator used by the structure.

method.name: Data
method.description: Gives the data structure for initialization of cell size and tolerance.

method.name: ClearDomain
method.description: Removes all elements.

method.name: ClearDeleted
method.description: Substitutes deleted items by the last one from corresponding map to have only non-deleted elements, links or nodes in the structure.

method.name: call
method.description: Alias for GetNode.
